crossrefs.text: Then Jesus called out in a loud voice, “Father, into Your hands I commit My Spirit.” And when He had said this, He breathed His last.
It is just as the Scripture says: “Anyone who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”
While they were stoning him, Stephen appealed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.”
in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.
In You our fathers trusted; they trusted and You delivered them.
They cried out to You and were set free; they trusted in You and were not disappointed.
In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
Be my rock of refuge, where I can always go. Give the command to save me, for You are my rock and my fortress.

notes.title: Into your hands I commit my spirit

crossrefs.text: Shout for joy, O heavens; rejoice, O earth; break forth in song, O mountains! For the LORD has comforted His people, and He will have compassion on His afflicted ones.
In all their distress, He too was afflicted, and the Angel of His Presence saved them. In His love and compassion He redeemed them; He lifted them up and carried them all the days of old.
Indeed, He drew you from the jaws of distress to a spacious and broad place, to a table full of richness.
Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law.
How could one man pursue a thousand, or two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, unless the LORD had given them up?
Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved my distress; show me grace and hear my prayer.
He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.
But now that you know God, or rather are known by God, how is it that you are turning back to those weak and worthless principles? Do you wish to be enslaved by them all over again?
My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.
My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.

For I have heard the whispering of many: “Terror is on every side! Report him; let us report him!” All my trusted friends watch for my fall: “Perhaps he will be deceived so that we may prevail against him and take our vengeance upon him.”
There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.
From my youth I was afflicted and near death. I have borne Your terrors; I am in despair.
When morning came, all the chief priests and elders of the people conspired against Jesus to put Him to death.
When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.
For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah
Jesus replied, “It is not for you to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed by His own authority.
When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
In God, whose word I praise— in God I trust. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
Therefore Jesus told them, “Although your time is always at hand, My time has not yet come.
When Jesus had spoken these things, He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said, “Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son may glorify You.
The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
Many ask, “Who can show us the good?” Shine the light of Your face upon us, O LORD.
Listen to my cry, for I am brought quite low. Rescue me from my pursuers, for they are too strong for me.
Rather, as it is written: “No eye has seen, no ear has heard, no heart has imagined, what God has prepared for those who love Him.”
From ancient times no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides You, who acts on behalf of those who wait for Him.
They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
and into an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, reserved in heaven for you,
who through faith are shielded by Godʼs power for the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.
Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.
When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with Him in glory.
